destination.title: Charged spectra, coupling limits and light towers
destination.question: How do physical spectra, gauge interactions and geometric limits determine light towers, their stability and their effective descriptions?
destination.summary: A proposed organizing family, with a core in asymptotic towers and charged spectra and neighboring directions in ordinary spectrum dynamics, protected counting and extended-object forces. No original scientific scope statement accompanies the numerical membership, so its acceptance cannot be inferred from proximity.

systems: String and M-theory compactifications in the dimensions specified by each source
Einstein-coupled effective theories with massless moduli
Related supersymmetric gauge theories and SCFT spectra
targets: Physical tower identification and effective descriptions
Spectrum population, stability and charge-to-mass or tension relations
Gauge coupling, scalar distance and emergence
Protected counting and force calculations as distinct supporting directions
regimes: Finite or strong coupling when testing spectrum persistence
Finite-distance singularities and ordinary spectrum deformations as comparisons
assumptions: A candidate charge orbit does not establish a populated stable spectrum
Gravity, supersymmetry and spacetime dimension are source-specific
Conjectural existence, conditional deductions and explicit calculations remain distinct
conventions: Superextremality and self-repulsion are not interchangeable
Particle masses and extended-object tensions require separate dictionaries
Protected indices, physical degeneracies and unprotected spectra are distinct
includes: Independent tests of asymptotic geometry and spectral predictions
excludes: Automatic membership from shared BPS, gauge or string terminology
Standalone chiral model construction without a supplied connection to coupling-limit spectra
Framing/PCA studies treated as evidence for physical distance towers
Universal proofs inferred from abstracts or bounded examples

sources.title: Infinite Distances in Field Space and Massless Towers of States

evidence.text: Can Calabi–Yau degeneration geometry identify an infinite tower satisfying the Swampland Distance Conjecture, and can integrating out that tower explain infinite field distance and weak gauge coupling?

sources.title: Tensionless Strings and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Do the charged states survive at finite coupling, and how does the weak-gauge limit map to RR-charged BPS sectors and complex-structure limits in other duality frames?

sources.title: Tensionless Strings and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Do the high-charge states and their superextremality survive after leaving the weakly coupled tensionless regime?

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture for Kähler moduli

evidence.text: Which candidate charges are stable physical states near infinite distance, and does their populated number grow as required by species and emergence arguments?

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture for Kähler moduli

evidence.text: Can the small-fiber orbit realize the KK tower of the additional F-theory circle, and can integrating out that tower reproduce an infinite-distance metric?

sources.title: Modular Fluxes, Elliptic Genera, and Weak Gravity Conjectures in Four Dimensions

evidence.text: Does a gravity-coupled U(1) weak-coupling limit in chiral four-dimensional N=1 F-theory produce an asymptotically light super-extremal tower, and how do gauge fluxes affect the elliptic-genus argument?

sources.title: Swampland Distance Conjecture for One-Parameter Calabi-Yau Threefolds

evidence.text: Can the complete light spectrum reproduce the prepotential terms responsible for infinite distance, and can K-point BPS states be organized into a concrete higher-genus counting problem?

sources.title: Swampland conjectures for type IIB orientifolds with closed-string U(1)s

evidence.text: Explain the regular mixed-intersection dependence of the gauge coupling using the available particle spectrum, and determine whether the proposed global limit is compatible with a neutral obstructing tower.

sources.title: Merging the weak gravity and distance conjectures using BPS extremal black holes

evidence.text: Can the charged-tower formulation reproduce the SDC at every infinite-distance boundary, including limits whose natural weak field is a higher-form gauge field?

sources.title: Merging the weak gravity and distance conjectures using BPS extremal black holes

evidence.text: How do extremal black holes and light towers behave near infinite distance with several scalar and gauge fields? The principal setting is four-dimensional N=2 Type IIB compactification on a Calabi–Yau threefold.

sources.title: Weak gravity bounds in asymptotic string compactifications

evidence.text: How do wrapped-D3 BPS charges and masses behave near boundaries of complex-structure moduli space, and what constraints follow for their electric charge-to-mass spectrum?

sources.title: Weak gravity bounds in asymptotic string compactifications

evidence.text: Can a type III boundary involve all complex-structure parameters, or must it retain a finite spectator?

sources.title: Lectures on the Swampland Program in String Compactifications

evidence.text: Which towers resolve the large- and small-radius limits, and are the printed canonical and gauge conventions mutually consistent?

sources.title: Physics of infinite complex structure limits in eight dimensions

evidence.text: What physical towers and effective descriptions occur at infinite complex structure distance in eight-dimensional F-theory on K3, and can quartic gauge couplings emerge entirely from integrating out massive towers?

sources.title: The asymptotic weak gravity conjecture in M-theory

evidence.text: Do charge rays lacking BPS towers nevertheless support asymptotically super-extremal non-BPS towers whenever the corresponding five-dimensional gauge combination admits a weak coupling limit?

sources.title: Yukawa couplings at infinite distance and swampland towers in chiral theories

evidence.text: When a physical Yukawa coupling of charged 4d chiral matter vanishes, is the limit at infinite distance, which towers become light, and how are their scales related to gauge couplings and matter metrics?

sources.title: Massive spectrum in F-theory and the distance conjecture

evidence.text: What massive BPS string-junction and selected KK spectra arise in F-theory, particularly when parallel 7-brane bunches collide into a codimension-one (4,6,12) degeneration, and how do their masses relate to the distance conjecture?

sources.title: Co-scaling and alignment of electric and magnetic towers

evidence.text: When do electrically and magnetically charged towers have parametrically comparable charge-to-mass/tension ratios and aligned charge directions, and can these relationships constrain quantum gravity and Calabi–Yau geometry?

sources.title: Physics and geometry of complex structure limits in type IIB Calabi-Yau compactifications

evidence.text: Do type III/IV infinite-distance complex-structure limits contain geometrically realized BPS towers with the masses and degeneracies needed for 6d/5d decompactification, and how do enhancement chains and trajectories determine the gravitational frame and coupled gauge sector?

sources.title: Minimal weak gravity conjecture and gauge duality in M-theory on $K3 \times T^{2}$

evidence.text: Does M-theory on finite-volume K3×T² provide the superextremal particle towers required by the minimal WGC in extreme coupling limits, and can a geometric correspondence relate the weakly and strongly coupled spectra?

sources.title: The D1 / D5 system and singular CFT

evidence.text: What happens to the D1/D5 boundary CFT when mutually BPS subsystems can separate at zero energy cost, and can long-string dynamics explain its continuum, singular behavior, and apparently missing chiral primaries?

sources.title: Infinite Distances in Field Space and Massless Towers of States

evidence.text: Construct monodromy orbits of massless charges and quotient M by the type II sublattice MII. Analyze central-charge phases and walls of marginal stability to motivate interpreting distinct quotient classes as stable BPS candidates.

sources.title: Tensionless Strings and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Allocate excitation among factors in proportion to their positive indices, then control integer rounding. For Jacobi products this yields a candidate large-level charge, whose survival still requires a nonzero final coefficient.

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture for Kähler moduli

evidence.text: Bound the norm of dK, apply Cauchy–Schwarz to the path velocity, and integrate its total variation. The operation avoids geodesic solutions and supplies a lower bound for paths within the controlled metric region.

sources.title: Modular Fluxes, Elliptic Genera, and Weak Gravity Conjectures in Four Dimensions

evidence.text: Combine Jacobi-form theta expansions and the heterotic mass-shell relation with an Einstein–Maxwell–dilaton extremality comparison, retaining the scalar contribution.

sources.title: Swampland Distance Conjecture for One-Parameter Calabi-Yau Threefolds

evidence.text: Given a proposed BPS decay, sum its complex central charges and compare the initial mass with the sum of daughter masses. Nonalignment excludes the channel. Alignment locates a possible marginal-stability wall but still requires quantized charges and actual daughter states.

sources.title: Swampland conjectures for type IIB orientifolds with closed-string U(1)s

evidence.text: Differentiate the Kähler potential, solve geodesics, integrate their length and substitute fixed-label masses. Verify the limit before interpreting the resulting exponent as a distance-conjecture test.

sources.title: Infinite Distance Networks in Field Space and Charge Orbits

evidence.text: Do the candidate orbit charges occur as stable BPS states near infinite distance? The authors propose asymptotic population while leaving the general spectrum and stability argument unresolved.

sources.title: Gopakumar-Vafa invariants and the Emergent String Conjecture

evidence.text: Do gauge-coupling asymptotics and charged BPS indices distinguish decompactification from emergent-string limits in five-dimensional supergravity, and do Calabi-Yau data satisfy the resulting geometric predictions of the Emergent String Conjecture?

sources.title: Stable nonBPS states in string theory

evidence.text: How do the masses and descriptions of stable, charge-protected non-BPS states behave at strong string coupling, where no BPS mass-charge formula applies? The paper asks when a weakly coupled dual description actually identifies the lightest charged state.

sources.title: Long range forces and supersymmetric bound states

evidence.text: Determine how long-range forces between BPS constituents diagnose the existence and disappearance of composite BPS and certain non-BPS states across marginal-stability loci, including regions where the microscopic gauge theory is strongly coupled.

sources.title: Infinite Distances and the Axion Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Which candidate charges admit BPS states, how stable towers extend beyond local orbit constructions, and whether isolated Type G or Type F states contribute independently remain unresolved.

sources.title: Decompactifications and Massless D-Branes in Hybrid Models

evidence.text: How can monodromy and D-brane probes determine asymptotic BPS masses and the geometry of GLSM hybrid limits, distinguishing genuine decompactification from finite-distance singularities with massless D-branes?

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric AdS and the Swampland

evidence.text: How do BPS and non-BPS charge sectors differ in the perturbative heterotic spectrum? Level matching ties the minimum excitation pattern to the difference p_L²−p_R².

sources.title: Infinite distance and zero gauge coupling in 5D supergravity

evidence.text: Which kinetic quantity measures weak gauge coupling, and how does it determine scalar distance? The full gauge matrix detects vanishing couplings through diverging eigenvalues, while scalar lengths use its pullback to fixed-volume tangent vectors.

sources.title: Merging the weak gravity and distance conjectures using BPS extremal black holes

evidence.text: Does every infinite-distance limit have a suitable massless higher-form gauge sector becoming weakly coupled, with a charged tower that can be compared to extremality?

sources.title: A Stringy Test of the Scalar Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a tower of non-BPS string excitations satisfy the precise charge-to-mass bound determined by both gravity and massless scalars, including in theories with several abelian gauge fields?

sources.title: Multiplet recombination and the CFT Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: What protected spectrum accompanies the higher-spin tower at an infinite-distance cusp where one gauge node becomes free but an interacting SCFT remains, and how does multiplet recombination explain it?

sources.title: Non-minimal elliptic threefolds at infinite distance II: asymptotic physics

evidence.text: Which asymptotically light towers arise at complex-structure infinite distance in six-dimensional F-theory, and how do decompactification, emergent strings and surviving defect gauge sectors explain these limits?

sources.title: Stability of BPS states and weak coupling limits

evidence.text: Does asymptotic mass growth as a gauge coupling tends to zero constrain BPS decays throughout the perturbative region, and what does this imply for the stability and population of light charged towers?

sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture and BPS Particles

evidence.text: Which charge directions have coincident BPS and black-hole extremality bounds, and what do the tower and sublattice WGC then require of BPS particles and holomorphic curves?

sources.title: Infinite distance and zero gauge coupling in 5D supergravity

evidence.text: Can light-particle towers account for both weak gauge coupling and infinite scalar distance? The introduction relates the limits through the tower conjectures and emergence, retaining a charged-particle assumption when inferring weak coupling from a distance tower.

sources.title: Fermions and the Swampland

evidence.text: How does an external fermion's gauge charge constrain its tower? Pairing differently charged levels into neutral Yukawa operators is proposed, without a general representation-theoretic construction.

sources.title: Weyl invariant Jacobi forms along Higgsing trees

evidence.text: How do BPS counting functions specialize along rank-1 Higgsing trees, and how far do symmetries of the massless spectrum constrain the massive BPS spectrum of the resulting 5d theories?

sources.title: A Note on Membrane Interactions and the Scalar potential

evidence.text: Can restrictions on scalar potentials be connected to the charged-object spectrum through a direct interaction calculation? The proposed setting replaces potential terms by scalar, graviton and three-form exchange between BPS membranes.

sources.title: Lectures on the Swampland Program in String Compactifications

evidence.text: What happens to an Einstein-coupled EFT near an infinite-distance scalar boundary, particularly one with vanishing gauge coupling?

sources.title: BPS structure of Argyres-Douglas superconformal theories

evidence.text: What light BPS spectra occur under small deformations of Argyres–Douglas conformal points, and how do these spectra change with deformation direction?

sources.title: Tensionless Strings and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: When does a protected world-sheet index determine a physical charge-to-mass spectrum? The paper uses right-moving level matching and an assumed perturbative mass relation near weak heterotic coupling.
